base:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a production sprite sheet for the existing Windows desktop cat app. Create an EIGHT-FRAME seamless natural WALK CYCLE of the exact cat in the reference. The reference is an existing 4x3 sheet: use its TOP ROW ONLY as appearance reference, replace the inadequate walk poses with a coherent new 8-pose cycle. Preserve the original realistic softly illustrated fur style, anatomy, face, markings, proportions and colors precisely.
Output: ONE sheet, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows (8 square cells), row-major chronological order. Each cell contains ONE complete cat in strict right-facing side view, walking IN PLACE. Every cell has exactly the same scale, torso length, spine height, shoulder and hip anchor, head position and floor baseline. Large clean margins. No cropped tail or ears. Pure solid chroma-key green #00ff00 everywhere except the cats. No floor, shadow, labels, numbers, lines or text.
Animation: eight consecutive evenly-spaced phases at 0%,12.5%,25%,37.5%,50%,62.5%,75%,87.5% of ONE full stride; phase 7 transitions smoothly to phase 0, do not duplicate the first frame at the end. Natural four-beat cat walk, not a trot, gallop, march or crouch. Each front paw alternates forward contact, body passing over it, back extension and low swing recovery; the other front paw is offset half a stride. Hind paws use natural cat digitigrade hocks and understated flexion; each hind paw follows its same-side front paw with a small time offset. Four legs only, no extra paws, no grossly bent rear knees. Relaxed nearly level torso, very small natural body motion, planted feet share a single baseline; lifted paws clear the floor by only a little. Head stays steady, tail has only very subtle smooth sway. All markings must be identical throughout. The near foreleg MUST visibly progress from forward contact through vertical support to back extension and recovery, instead of staying forward in every cell. High-quality game-ready sprite artwork.
revision:
Precise-object-edit for an animation asset. Reference IMAGE 1 is an EXACT EIGHT-FRAME LEG-POSE GUIDE. Reference IMAGE 2 is the cat artwork to correct. Keep the realistic cat's face, body, scale, coat, texture, green background and exact 4-column by 2-row grid from IMAGE 2. Change ONLY the four leg poses in EACH cell to MATCH the corresponding cell in IMAGE 1. This corrects a defect: the previous animation repeats a forward-reaching front leg in almost every pose; we need real forward-to-backward stepping.
Red in guide = camera-near front leg; blue = camera-near hind leg; grey = far-side legs. These colors are ONLY instructions, do not add any red or blue color to the cat. Render ALL legs in the cat's own fur.
Pose requirements, row major:
1: near forepaw forward on floor, near hind leg supports under hip.
2: near forepaw approaching vertical support, near hind leg starts extending backward.
3: near forepaw directly under shoulder on floor, near hind leg extended backward on floor.
4: near forepaw now BEHIND shoulder on floor, near hind paw lifted low behind body.
5: near forepaw FARTHEST BACK on floor, far forepaw FORWARD on floor; near hind foot swings forward.
6: near forepaw lifted slightly behind shoulder, far front leg vertical; near hind foot reaches ahead.
7: near forepaw lifted directly below shoulder, far forepaw behind shoulder; near hind foot plants.
8: near forepaw low swinging forward ready for frame 1 contact.
The eight phases form a single smooth continuous walking loop, NOT repeated contacts, not eight variations of the same pose. Absolutely preserve the artwork torso, head, face, eyes, tail shape and coat marking positions across all frames, same canvas alignment. Natural cat limbs, understated hind-knee flexion, four feet only. Do not copy the cartoon body of the guide, ONLY its chronological leg placement. Output exactly 8 fully visible realistic cats, same size, same floor level, all right-facing. Solid #00ff00 background, no diagram, no lines, no labels, no floor, no shadows.
